limits: Excluded Cause Fear, Confusion, Hold Person and Hold Monster use real public native terminal applications with their original ability contexts. This is not an area Confusion cast into the working-save party or proof of its saving-throw casting path.
Optional Control Undead, Control Construct and Animal Servant use real terminal-only applications and equivalent neutral-controller positive cases; no optional full spell/hex cast claim.

The native RuleSummonUnit creates and links the real registered Succubus. Only its request-owned appearance staging buff is ended before its real domination cast; no summon spell slot or placement claim.
All four circles cover the native summon. Succubus natural Chaotic Evil differs from Lawful Good summoner; Evil/Chaos block and Good/Law allow the actual failed-save domination.
Same-scene UnitEntityData.Translocate and permanent bearer despawn qualify; final disk/scene/profile/UI cases remain pending.
